Title: Path Traversal Bypass in EnforceToCurrentRoot due to Missing Path Cleaning
Analysis:
In `util/security/path_traversal.go`, the function `EnforceToCurrentRoot` checks if a `requestedPath` is on or under `currentRoot`. 
However, it does not clean or evaluate the `requestedPath` using `filepath.Clean` or `filepath.Abs` before validating it or returning it.
Instead, it splits the `requestedPath` using `parsePath` into `requestedDir` (which is `filepath.Dir(requestedPath)`) and `requestedFile` (which is `filepath.Base(requestedPath)`).
Since `filepath.Dir` preserves trailing relative elements if they are part of the input without resolving them, and `isRequestedDirUnderCurrentRoot` does not call `filepath.Clean` on `requestedDir` either, a path traversal bypass is possible.

Specifically:
If `currentRoot` is `/home/argo/helmapp`, and `requestedPath` is `/home/argo/helmapp/../../etc/passwd`, `parsePath` returns:
- `requestedDir` = `/home/argo/helmapp/../..`
- `requestedFile` = `passwd`

`isRequestedDirUnderCurrentRoot` receives `currentRoot = \"/home/argo/helmapp\"` and `requestedPath = \"/home/argo/helmapp/../..\"`.
It adds a trailing slash to `requestedPath` to make it `/home/argo/helmapp/../../`.
It checks if `/home/argo/helmapp/../../` has prefix `/home/argo/helmapp/` (after adding trailing slashes).
Indeed, `/home/argo/helmapp/../../` starts with `/home/argo/helmapp/`!
So `strings.HasPrefix(requestedPath, currentRoot)` returns `true`!

Then, the function returns:
`requestedDir + string(filepath.Separator) + requestedFile` which is `/home/argo/helmapp/../../passwd`, allowing complete directory traversal and out-of-bounds file access.

This function is used in `AppFilesHaveChanged` to verify if modified files are within designated refresh paths, but it is also a general utility function in the codebase.
Because there is no sanitization or cleaning of the requestedPath before calling `strings.HasPrefix`, any string starting with the prefix `/home/argo/helmapp` (e.g. `/home/argo/helmapp/../..`) will bypass the check.

Conceptual Exploit Payload:
Setting a file change path or a requested file path to:
`/home/argo/helmapp/../../etc/passwd`
will bypass the check and resolve to `/home/argo/helmapp/../../passwd` (i.e. `/home/etc/passwd` or `/etc/passwd`), accessing files outside of the `currentRoot` directory boundary.
